questions.cardText:
[Literature] Which of the following is considered the oldest known work of literature?
A. The Aeneid
B. The Iliad
C. The Epic of Gilgamesh
Answer: C. The Epic of Gilgamesh, written around 2000 BCE in ancient Mesopotamia, is widely recognized as the oldest known work of literature. The epic tells the story of Gilgamesh, the semi-mythical king of Uruk, and his adventures with his companion Enkidu.
questions.de: Welches altmesopotamische Epos über einen König von Uruk und seinen Gefährten Enkidu gilt als das älteste erhaltene Werk erzählender Literatur der Welt?
questions.en: Which ancient Mesopotamian epic about a king of Uruk and his companion Enkidu is regarded as the world's oldest surviving work of narrative literature?

timeline.labelEn: Earliest Sumerian poems about Gilgamesh, possibly from the Third Dynasty of Ur
timeline.labelDe: Früheste sumerische Gilgamesch-Dichtungen, vermutlich aus der Zeit der III. Dynastie von Ur

questions.notes: Wikipedia says 'oldest surviving example of narrative literature'; some shorter Sumerian texts (e.g. the Kesh Temple Hymn, the Instructions of Shuruppak) are older, so the question is framed as narrative literature. The Sumerian poems may date to c. 2100 BC, the first combined Old Babylonian version to the 18th century BC.

questions.cardText:
[Economics] What is “monetary policy” primarily concerned with?
A. Government budget allocations
B. The central bank’s control over the money supply and interest rates
C. Regulation of financial markets
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wie nennt man die Politik, mit der eine Zentralbank die Geldmenge und die Zinsen steuert?
questions.en: What is the name for the policy by which a central bank steers the money supply and interest rates?

timeline.labelEn: Founding of the Bank of England, an early milestone of central-bank monetary policy
timeline.labelDe: Gründung der Bank of England, ein früher Meilenstein zentralbankgesteuerter Geldpolitik

questions.notes: Government budget allocations (option A) are fiscal policy. German 'Geldpolitik' also accepted as 'Währungspolitik'/'monetäre Politik'.
